GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm (braces, CVSS 7.5 here): stack-exhaustion denial of service through deeply nested brace patterns. Affects braces <= 3.0.3; no fixed release exists (3.0.3 is the newest on the registry), so no update or override can resolve it.
Not reachable here. braces 3.0.3 arrives only through micromatch 4.0.8 in dev tooling (jest, stylelint, markdownlint-cli2, jscpd); `npm ls braces --omit=dev` is empty, so nothing in the published package loads it. The only patterns it expands are repo-controlled: the lint scripts' globs, the jest/stylelint/markdownlint configs, and the staged paths lint-staged passes. None come from network or user input.
Accepted until 2026-12-02, the fleet window for this advisory (Karl's standing decision of 2026-10-04; the same entry as AFixt/single-page-tester#239 and AFixt/engine-research#279). This repo has no tracking issue of its own for it. Pinned by src/tests/accepted-advisories.test.js. Reviewed by Karl Groves (standing acceptance, 2026-10-04); recorded here 2026-10-05 for AFixt/fleet-security#4.

extract-zip <= 2.0.1, symlink path traversal / arbitrary file write (CVSS 8.1): GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv, which NVD lists as CVE-2026-56876, and GHSA-7pqw-9j4j-h8q3. No fixed release exists: 2.0.1 is the newest extract-zip and first_patched_version is null for both.
Dev-only: `npm ls extract-zip --omit=dev` is empty. The single consumer is @afixt/a11y-assert 2.1.3 -> puppeteer 24.43.1 -> @puppeteer/browsers 2.13.2, which depends on extract-zip ^2.0.1. The only archive it opens is the Chrome build puppeteer downloads over HTTPS from Google's CDN, so exploiting it means already controlling that download. The path free of extract-zip (puppeteer 25, as afixt-engine-v6 here already uses) needs an @afixt/a11y-assert major upgrade, which is out of scope for this gate change.
Accepted until 2026-11-14, the date AFixt/single-page-tester set for the same two advisories (#163, mirrored in its #241), so it is looked at again then. This repo has no tracking issue of its own for it. Pinned by src/tests/accepted-advisories.test.js. Reviewed 2026-10-05 for AFixt/fleet-security#4. Not yet a standing decision for this repo: merging this file is the acceptance here.
